description: Layered enterprise-grade review gate for high-risk work: requirements -> architecture -> data model -> interface contract -> implementation -> tests -> operations/observability -> security -> migration/rollback -> acceptance. It is a scheduling prior for the host agent, not a standing committee or a mandatory command path.

steps.label: scope-triage
steps.description: Host maps the work to the ten audit layers and declares which layers are mandatory for this run. High-risk changes default to all ten layers; small fixes may explicitly exempt irrelevant layers with a reason and evidence.
steps.expected_artifact: layer-scope matrix with mandatory/exempt status and exemption reasons
steps.stop_condition: every layer is either mandatory or explicitly exempted before dispatch

steps.label: layer-fanout
steps.description: Dispatch independent read-only auditors against disjoint or deliberately overlapping layer assignments. For high-risk work, use at least three distinct model families across the review squad and exclude the host family. Each auditor must read the real artifact/repo state and return structured findings.
steps.expected_artifact: per-layer findings JSON plus proof-of-read for layers with no findings
steps.stop_condition: every mandatory layer has at least one auditor report or a recorded dispatch failure

steps.label: redline-gate
steps.description: Union-merge findings and classify redlines. Redlines are blocking by default: unresolved user need contradiction, undefined cross-module architecture boundary, unsafe or destructive data migration, interface contract drift, implementation/spec mismatch, missing regression test for changed behavior, missing observability for a new module, auth/secret/permission flaw, no executable rollback for irreversible change, or unverifiable acceptance.
steps.expected_artifact: redline register with severity, layer, evidence, and owner
steps.stop_condition: all redlines are registered; none are dropped by vote or deduplication

steps.label: host-synthesis
steps.description: Host verifies every cited blocker first-hand. Adopt real blockers, reject false positives only with a falsification note, and route direction disputes to direction-review. Findings are union-merged; this path never votes away minority blockers.
steps.stop_condition: every finding has a disposition backed by first-hand evidence

steps.label: remediation-loop
steps.description: Fix adopted blockers, pin each changed invariant with tests or acceptance evidence, rerun only the affected layers, and repeat until HIGH+CRITICAL redlines reach zero or the human explicitly overrides with recorded residual risk.
steps.expected_artifact: fix evidence, test-pin evidence, refreshed layer findings, audit ledger rows
steps.stop_condition: zero open HIGH/CRITICAL redlines, or explicit human override with residual risk

steps.label: acceptance-record
steps.description: Write the final layer gate record. It must show each layer as passed, exempted, or human-overridden; include the commands/artifacts read; and link to the audit ledger and release/privacy gates when relevant.
steps.expected_artifact: enterprise-audit-gate record referenced from run state
steps.stop_condition: all mandatory layers pass, all exemptions have reasons, all overrides are human-approved

redline_policy: requirements: no done_when/acceptance criteria, or implementation contradicts an explicit user requirement
architecture: cross-module boundary, ownership, lifecycle, or dependency direction is undefined for shared state
data-model: schema/persistence change lacks invariant, migration safety, or data-loss analysis
interface-contract: request/response shape, pagination, error, enum, or compatibility contract drift is untested
implementation: code path contradicts spec, swallows errors, widens side effects, or has uncontrolled concurrency
testing: changed behavior or audit-raised invariant lacks a passing regression/contract test
operations-observability: new module has no structured logs, doctor/healthcheck entry, or failure-query path
security: auth bypass, tenant isolation break, secret leak, unsafe permission widening, or command injection risk
migration-rollback: irreversible step has no dry-run, backup, rollback, or staged rollout evidence
acceptance: final verdict relies on remembered success, exit code only, or missing human gate for irreversible actions
stop_conditions: scope matrix covers all ten layers before auditors run
mandatory layers have heterogeneous read-only audit evidence
findings are union-merged, never majority-voted away
every HIGH/CRITICAL redline is fixed, falsified with evidence, or human-overridden
each audit-raised invariant is pinned by a test, contract check, command output, or explicit acceptance artifact
final layer gate record is referenced from the run state before closeout
anti_patterns: ap1:ceremonial-all-layers — running ten layers on a tiny change without scope triage or exemptions
ap2:committee-as-router — letting the path choose the workflow instead of the host agent
ap3:vote-away-redlines — treating 2/3 approval as permission to drop a cited blocker
ap4:single-auditor-all-layers — one model audits every layer and the result is called independent review
ap5:exit-code-acceptance — passing acceptance because scripts exited 0 while artifacts and contracts were not read
